card.name: Inside split-up long medical words
card.fires_on: The piece partway through a long word that is split up, mostly the B in EXACERBATION in all-caps hepatitis B warnings. Also seen in Transfusional and Affidavits.

modes.label: EXACERBATION in warnings
modes.description: The B inside the capitalised word EXACERBATION in boxed hepatitis warnings.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Middle or end pieces of less common words such as Transfusional or Affidavits.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Transf<<us>>ional Iron Overload: Initial dose for

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a long word that the model reads in pieces, especially EXACERBATION in hepatitis B warnings.
